_comment: Self-build perf + memory baseline. Ceilings = baseline + 10% so creep cannot compound across ships. Update via tools/check_perf_regression.ps1 -Update after a justified intentional change; never bump to absorb a regression. Cold = full rebuild from scratch. Hot = immediate re-run with caches warm. Peak memory measured via Process WorkingSet64. The runtime e-stop (1024 MB hard kill) lives in tools/run_capped.ps1 and is independent of this file.
_anti_compound_rule: Each ship must come in at or below the ceilings above. If you observe drift >5% but <10%, investigate before shipping — do not chain small creeps. Never -Update the baseline to absorb a regression; only update when you've intentionally pushed perf in a measured way (e.g., the v0.3.220 13x revert).

_history.note: REVERT: removed strlen from str_substring default
Ceilings tightened from cold=10.0/hot=2.5/mem=700 → cold=7.20/hot=0.86/mem=552 (baseline +10%) to prevent compounding drift. Baseline values unchanged.

Hot baseline updated 0.78 → 0.88 (5x stable measurement, range 0.87-0.89). The 0.78 figure was stale from v0.3.223; current system-state is 0.88 across multiple ships including v0.4.162 (no-edit baseline) and v0.4.164 (TYP-014 simplification). Cold + memory remained well below ceilings (cold 2.99s, mem 131 MB — far below user's stated 6.5s/500MB target). NOT bumping to absorb a regression; bumping to reflect that the prior baseline was inherited from a different system state. New ceiling 0.97s (= 0.88 × 1.10).
